claims.claimText: Digital Personal Data Protection: India's Privacy Law Comes of Age
claims.normalizedText: digital personal data protection indias privacy law comes age

claims.claimText: From the landmark right to privacy judgment to the 2026 amendments, India's journey toward comprehensive data protection legislation has been long and contentious.
claims.normalizedText: from landmark right privacy judgment 2026 amendments indias journey toward comprehensive data protection legislation has been long and contentious

claims.claimText: Supreme Court declared right to privacy a fundamental right in 2017
claims.normalizedText: supreme court declared right privacy fundamental right 2017

claims.claimText: DPDP Act 2023 received presidential assent after 6 years of deliberation
claims.normalizedText: dpdp act 2023 received presidential assent after 6 years deliberation

claims.claimText: 2026 amendments expanded regulatory scope and compliance requirements
claims.normalizedText: 2026 amendments expanded regulatory scope and compliance requirements

claims.claimText: Tech companies face fines up to ₹250 crore for non-compliance
claims.normalizedText: tech companies face fines up 250 crore noncompliance

claims.claimText: India's DPDP Act imposes the highest data privacy fines in the world.
claims.normalizedText: indias dpdp act imposes highest data privacy fines world

registeredClaimMatch.statement: India's DPDP Act imposes the highest data privacy fines in the world.

claims.claimText: The DPDP Act exempts government agencies from all provisions.
claims.normalizedText: dpdp act exempts government agencies from all provisions

registeredClaimMatch.statement: The DPDP Act exempts government agencies from all provisions.

claims.claimText: [2017-08-24] Right to Privacy Judgment: Supreme Court in Justice K.S. Puttaswamy case declares right to privacy a fundamental right under Article 21.
claims.normalizedText: 20170824 right privacy judgment supreme court justice ks puttaswamy case declares right privacy fundamental right under article 21

claims.claimText: [2018-07-27] Srikrishna Committee Report: BN Srikrishna-led committee submits draft Personal Data Protection Bill to the government.
claims.normalizedText: 20180727 srikrishna committee report bn srikrishnaled committee submits draft personal data protection bill government

claims.claimText: [2019-12-11] PDP Bill Introduced: Personal Data Protection Bill 2019 introduced in Lok Sabha, later referred to Joint Parliamentary Committee.
claims.normalizedText: 20191211 pdp bill introduced personal data protection bill 2019 introduced lok sabha later referred joint parliamentary committee

claims.claimText: [2023-08-11] DPDP Act Receives Assent: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 receives presidential assent, replacing the 2019 bill.
claims.normalizedText: 20230811 dpdp act receives assent digital personal data protection act 2023 receives presidential assent replacing 2019 bill

claims.claimText: [2026-03-20] 2026 Amendments Pass Lok Sabha: Amendments to DPDP Act passed in Lok Sabha, expanding data fiduciary obligations and cross-border data flow rules.
claims.normalizedText: 20260320 2026 amendments pass lok sabha amendments dpdp act passed lok sabha expanding data fiduciary obligations and crossborder data flow rules

claims.claimText: Who does the DPDP Act apply to?: The Act applies to the processing of digital personal data within India and to data processed outside India if it relates to offering goods or services to individuals in India.
claims.normalizedText: who does dpdp act apply act applies processing digital personal data within india and data processed outside india if it relates offering goods or services individuals india

claims.claimText: What rights do citizens have under the DPDP Act?: Citizens have the right to access, correct, erase personal data, and the right to grievance redressal. Data fiduciaries must obtain explicit consent before processing personal data.
claims.normalizedText: what rights do citizens have under dpdp act citizens have right access correct erase personal data and right grievance redressal data fiduciaries must obtain explicit consent before processing personal data
